# Greene Studios

> Digital design studio. Greene Studios designs and builds brands, websites and apps, one team from the first sketch to launch day.

## Pages
- [Home](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/): what the studio does, selected work, services, questions
- [Work](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/work): client projects (AiPal, PayVault, Strike, S.A.F.E., Crypto with Shola, Greene Studios) and live sites
- [Gallery](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/gallery): every picture from the work in one scroll
- [Services](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/services): brand identity, web design, UI/UX, frontend development, motion, product design, web applications, AI integration, design systems, SEO
- [Pricing](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/pricing): packages and smaller jobs
- [Blueprint](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/blueprint): the brand guide: logo, type, colours (HEX, RGB, CMYK), imagery and patterns
- [Map](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/map): every page on the site
- [Studio](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/studio): who we are and how we work
- [Team](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/team): the people at Greene
- [Journal](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/journal): notes on design and building products
- [Start here](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/start): six-question quiz that recommends a starting package
- [Contact](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/contact): send a project brief

## Packages (USD; every project is quoted after a short call)
- Brand Identity: $480, 1 to 3 weeks
- Website: $690, 1 to 3 weeks
- Product Build: from $2,000, 2 to 4 months
- Monthly Retainer: $490 a month
